cohort: The study included five pregnant patients, presenting with early onset preeclampsia (EPE), late onset preeclampsia (LPE), gestational hypertension (GH), essential hypertension (EH), and an uncomplicated pregnancy (UP) respectively.
finding: Maternal venous pulse transit times (VPTT) were normal in early pregnancy but became abnormal in cases of early onset and late onset preeclampsia, supporting the view that venous hemodynamic dysfunction of preeclampsia develops during the course of pregnancy.
